1.

Crucified in weakness, but raised in power, Thou didst ascend to heaven’s heights, There Thou reignest, Jesus, God’s only-begotten Son, God’s source of eternal joys.

2.

And heaven’s hosts in worship behold The glorious victory Thou hast won, And man is saved from death and from woe, For God a propitiation hath found.

3.

On high in the bliss and rest of the Godhead Thou wilt our hearts introduce, Thy presence, O Lord, now our home doth constitute, For Thee, Thee alone we belong.

4.

A holy right now unto us doth pertain, Entirely delivered we may be, No longer in Adam, in Thee we now stand, An offering, priestly company.

5.

The glorious testimony written indeed is By the Spirit’s divine pen. Highly exalted Jesus, our heart then learns Thy Father ever better to know.
